'''Kobothi Space''' was the region in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], on the fringe of the [[Tingel Arm/Legends|Tingel Arm]] near [[Trianii Space/Legends|Trianii Space]] and the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]]. It was inhabited by the [[Kobok/Legends|Koboks]], who weare [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Koboth]].
